svg.text: not visible from here — heard, not seen
no windows, no sign of what is inside
to the neighbour — the data centre gives
a heat sink — the place gives
sound: not computed at this spot
the screen gives 50–56 dBA at the homes 30–60 m away
seen: the podium, the tower, the entrance
documented: the chiller room · withheld: one item
Study H — eye level. Indicative massing; figures from the 555 W Hastings test run.
